description: Synthetic, license-safe gold evaluation corpus for the Draft Room drafting feature. Every name, organisation, place, date, number and quotation in this corpus is invented. It exists so that factual preservation can be measured against a deterministic oracle rather than an LLM judge.

normalization.newlines: CRLF and CR are normalised to LF before offsets are computed
normalization.note: All start/end offsets are character offsets into the normalised text. All document sha256 values are over the raw file bytes; all span sha256 values are over the utf-8 encoding of the spanned substring of the normalised text.

scenarios.description: Straightforward single-manuscript rewrite grounded in the controlling specification and safety datasheet.
Two references that conflict with each other on calibration interval, accuracy, and elevation policy.
A superseded source and a current source distinguished by as-of date.
Exact certified quotations plus near-quote traps that differ only in punctuation, numeral form, or a dropped article.
An OCR-degraded permit scan that still carries factually load-bearing permit conditions.
Opinion mixed with verifiable fact inside a single document.
Prompt injection payloads embedded in every source role: manuscript, reference, style, background, and challenge.
Identically named files in two different vaults with different content, used to prove cross-tenant isolation.
A style exemplar containing deliberately false facts, used to prove style inputs are never a factual authority.
Required qualifications that must not be dropped, including deliberately awkward but factually necessary hedges.

locked_spans.reason: Safety prohibition. Any softening, merging, or omission of these clauses is a safety regression.
Exposure response instruction; order of operations is load-bearing.
Permit condition recovered from a degraded scan; the numeric limit must survive OCR normalisation.
Permit identifier. The OCR artefacts are in the source; the identifier itself must not be altered.
Required qualification. Dropping it is a factual-preservation failure by definition.
Required qualification tied to regulatory exposure.
Causal attribution from the controlling specification; the challenge memo asserts the opposite.

reviewers.process: Every expected outcome in this manifest was curated independently by two reviewers. Each reviewer labelled expected_status, high_stakes, required and category for every proposition without seeing the other's labels. Disagreements were escalated to the product owner, whose adjudication is recorded as the final label.

reviewer_a.scope: all documents, propositions, quotes, locked spans, contradictions

reviewer_b.scope: all documents, propositions, quotes, locked spans, contradictions

adjudicator.role: adjudicates reviewer disagreements; adjudication is final
adjudicator.scope: any label where reviewer_a and reviewer_b disagreed

adjudicated_items.adjudication: ambiguous - the specification bounds operation and the datasheet bounds storage; the corpus must not force a single reading.

adjudicated_items.disagreement: reviewer_a labelled supported; reviewer_b labelled unsupported.
adjudicated_items.adjudication: ambiguous - the manuscript reports an apparent uplift in instrumented plots and does not establish causation.
